---
title: Themes
description: CSS theme files for customizing reveal.js presentation appearance.
---

slidecn themes customize the look and feel of your presentations by setting reveal.js CSS custom properties.

## Usage

Import the CSS file into your layout or presentation page:

```tsx
import "@/components/slides/themes/theme-default.css";
```

## Available Themes

- **Default** — Light theme with neutral tones
- **Dark** — Dark background, light text
- **Minimal** — Clean, minimal design with larger base font
- **Brand** — Starter template with brand color variables

## Custom Theme

The brand theme includes placeholder CSS variables for your brand colors. Uncomment and customize:

```css
.reveal {
  --brand-primary: #6366f1;
  --brand-secondary: #8b5cf6;
  --brand-bg: #0f0f1a;
  --brand-text: #f8fafc;
}
```

## Registration

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://slidecn.dev/r/theme-default.json
npx shadcn@latest add https://slidecn.dev/r/theme-dark.json
npx shadcn@latest add https://slidecn.dev/r/theme-minimal.json
npx shadcn@latest add https://slidecn.dev/r/theme-brand.json
```
